t: The One Way Non-Members Can Still Get Gas At Costco - Jalopnik
s: 2 days ago - Costco's fuel stations are built around a simple premise: access is reserved for members. However, with the help of a Costco Shop Card, you won't need anything more. Anyone paying with a Costco Shop Card is allowed to purchase fuel even without a membership. Granted, you can't get these cards in the first place if you aren't a member, but anyone can use it at their leisure once it's in their hands (if it isn't stolen, at least).
